description: Searches stations by callsign prefix and, for terms of 4 or more characters, by words in the station's beacon comment (for example a locality or club name typed by the operator). Returns up to 25 matches with callsign, type, position (WGS84), comment and last-heard time (UTC); exact callsign matches come first, then most recently heard.

query.description: Callsign prefix or short comment word, 4–9 characters: letters, digits and . / + - only.

name: search_stations
title: Search APRS stations
